Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Mostly Armless]]: the cover of Douglas Adams's novel ''Mostly Harmless''.

Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Mostly_Harmless_Harmony_front.jpg Mostly Harmless Harmony front.jpg], Wikipedia, shown on the Wikipedia article [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mostly_Harmless Mostly Harmless]. Preserved copy of the article: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008112519/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mostly_Harmless Internet Archive], 8 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (300 pixels tall) of the cover of Douglas Adams's novel ''Mostly Harmless'', the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of the work exists.
